	Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and early applications are encouraged.
	Portfolio submission is compulsory.

Graphics Designer Job at MRT Net Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        MRT Net Solutions Limited - Our client, a design company in Abuja, is recruiting a creative and detail-oriented candidate to fill the position below:

Job Position: Graphics Designer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	A design company in Abuja is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphics Designer to join its team on a full-time, onsite basis.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for producing visually compelling designs that support the company's branding, marketing, and communication objectives.


Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Create engaging graphics for social media, branding, advertising, and other marketing materials.
	Develop creative concepts and translate briefs into high-quality visual designs.
	Collaborate with team members to understand project requirements and deliver designs that meet expectations.
	Maintain consistency in brand identity across all design materials.
	Review and revise designs based on feedback.
	Keep up with current design trends, tools, and industry best practices.
	Manage multiple assignments and deliver projects within agreed deadlines.


Requirements


	Proven experience as a Graphics Designer.
	A strong portfolio demonstrating relevant design skills and previous work.
	Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, or equivalent industry-standard tools.
	Strong creativity, visual communication skills, and attention to detail.
	Ability to interpret briefs, receive feedback, and work collaboratively.
	Good time management and the ability to meet deadlines.
	Must reside in Abuja and be available to work onsite on a full-time basis.


Remuneration
Salary will be negotiated based on the candidate's skills, experience, and demonstrated competence.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using "Graphics Designer – Abuja" as the email subject.

Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and early applications are encouraged.
	Portfolio submission is compulsory.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Depot Admin

Job Location: Lekki/Jakande axis, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

	Coordinate daily administrative activities at the depot.
	Maintain accurate records of stock movement, deliveries, receipts, and dispatches.
	Monitor inventory and ensure proper documentation of goods received and released.
	Prepare daily and periodic operational reports.
	Coordinate with the warehouse, logistics, accounts, and head office teams.
	Ensure compliance with company procedures and maintain proper depot records.


Important Requirement


	Applicants must reside around the Lekki/Jakande axis for ease of commuting and effective performance of duties.


Method of application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV to: [email protected] and copy [email protected] using “Depot Administrator” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

        WTS Energy provides recruitment and manpower services for the global oil and gas and energy industries. We supply engineers and consultants to our clients' projects and operations, and perform employment outsourcing services such as workforce management in oil and gas regions around the world. WTS Energy operates globally with offices in 14 countries and is operational in over 50 countries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply Chain Management Lead 3 – Growth Projects and Wells

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary

	Lead commercial procurement for drilling and well services, approved upstream and gas developments,refinery expansion, the industrial park and capital engineering packages.
	Secure contractor capability and long-lead supply aligned to investment and delivery gates.


Responsibilities


	Lead supply chain management for growth projects and wells, including contractor prequalification, competitive tenders, commercial evaluation and negotiations.
	Develop and implement contracting strategies for drilling services, engineering, construction and equipment.
	Manage major tenders, schedule risk and claims.
	Oversee onshore E&P and refinery supply interfaces, contractor-led execution, critical equipment, operational shutdowns and remote-site logistics.
	Ensure compliance with Nigerian Content requirements and applicable NCDMB contracting steps, NUPRC or NMDPRA permissions.

Required:


	Degree or equivalent relevant professional qualification in supply chain, Engineering, Business, Finance, Law or a related field; 10–15 or more years in wells or capital-project contracting, with major tenders, schedule risk and claims
	Nigerian onshore execution experience
	Experience with Nigerian Content requirements and applicable NCDMB contracting steps, NUPRC or NMDPRA permissions
	Experience in onshore E&P and refinery supply interfaces, contractor-led execution, critical equipment, operational shutdowns and remote-site logistics
	Experience leading contractor prequalification, competitive tenders, commercial evaluation and negotiations, developing contracting strategies for drilling services, engineering, construction and equipment
	Based in Nigeria.


Preferred:


	MCIPS or equivalent demonstrated professional capability
